title: Flow sequence: Shows more information about various skinny messages
description:
For many skinny messages additional information is shown next to
message. It simplifies call flow analysis.


(cherry picked from commit e880cf61d7a7c2f9c4f5aa05add465bb3debb642)

notes.body:
This patch is "faulty": The first line of the file reads
`/* Do not modify this file. Changes will be overwritten */`
and a bit further down:
```
/*
 * Generated Automatically Using (from wireshark base directory):
 *   cog.py -D xmlfile=tools/SkinnyProtocolOptimized.xml -d -c -o epan/dissectors/packet-skinny.c epan/dissectors/packet-skinny.c.in
 */
```

Please fix, otherwise the patch will be overwritten and thus lost by the next "proper" patch.
Huh, I really missed it. Thank you for notice, I'm going to change it in packet-skinny.c.in
Hi. Fixed as !4906. It was out of sync for longer time...
